title: ToolDNS：基于DNS的AI工具发现框架
summary: ToolDNS提出一种基于DNS的语义工具发现框架，将工具发现转化为O(log N)的域名解析，在33868个真实工具基准上减少95.26%搜索空间，匹配最先进检索精度，延迟降低数个数量级。
summary_en: ToolDNS proposes a DNS-based semantic tool discovery framework, transforming tool discovery into O(log N) name resolutions, reducing search space by 95.26% on a 33,688 real-world tool benchmark while matching state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy and reducing latency by orders of magnitude.
